items.title: Mercor raises $750M at a $20bn valuation
items.summary: Mercor, which supplies experts and training data to AI labs, announced a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation, double the $10 billion after its October 2025 Series C. Nvidia, Salesforce and Zoom reportedly participate; details vary between sources.
items.why_it_matters: Human expert data for model training still drives big valuations.
